name: Home Screen Sections Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs and saves hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home-section drafts using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries. It does not yet render the saved sections.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Sections Manager design and Abyss customization UI for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Fixes Jellyfin 10.11.11 page loading so the full section-type editor and Customization Settings handlers run, exactly matches the other plugins plain tab buttons, tightens native type-picker spacing, keeps the picker visible while advancing, applies Abyss CSS through the official Branding endpoints, and restores the standard Dashboard save alert. Test only; it does not yet render actual home-screen sections.
